title: Beyond Arrow’s Impossibility: Fairness as an Emergent Property of Multi-Agent Collaboration
reasoning: The paper explicitly benchmarks and evaluates Large Language Models based on six distinct ethical frameworks: Utilitarianism, Rawlsianism, Egalitarianism, Libertarianism, Prioritarianism, and Care Ethics. It investigates how these frameworks influence agent negotiation and resource allocation outcomes, particularly in the context of fairness and bias mitigation.
